description.value: Damiko Sushi is a Japanese restaurant occupying a retail unit on King George Boulevard in Surrey, BC. It is the sole remaining open location following the permanent closure of the Langley branch, and offers both dine-in service and online ordering. Touring cyclists riding the King George corridor will find it a convenient stop for a sushi meal.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (8 spaces) at 90m. Total: 8 spaces.
